# Backspn

> Backspn is free, open source DJ software for macOS, Windows and Linux, written in Rust and made
> for any controller. Mix with sync and keylock, split any track into stems on your own machine,
> and play 74 effects on the beat. It is in public beta: every listed feature is finished.

- License: GPL-3.0-or-later
- Repository: https://github.com/suitux/Backspn
- Downloads: https://github.com/suitux/Backspn/releases (macOS .dmg, Windows .exe, Linux .deb and AppImage)
- Stack: Rust, egui/eframe, cpal, Symphonia, SQLite (rusqlite), ONNX Runtime (ort), Signalsmith Stretch
- Support the author: https://buymeacoffee.com/suitux

## What it is for

DJs who want a full mixing application without a subscription or a locked ecosystem. Backspn
plays on two or four decks, works with native HID controllers, MIDI profiles or MIDI learn, and
reads the libraries of other DJ applications, so you can bring your collection and your mappings
with you. Everything it writes uses its own open formats.

## Features

- Decks and mixer: two or four decks, sync to a master clock (half and double time included),
  keylock, eight hotcues, loops and beat jump from 1/32 to 64 beats, slip and reverse. Four
  channel mixer with isolator EQ, standard or resonant club filter, crossfader, headphone cue on
  a second output and a master limiter.
- Stems: split any track into drums, bass, other and vocals on the CPU, offline once the model is
  downloaded. Stem decks give each part its own volume, filter and FX send. Results are cached.
  .stem.mp4 files load as stems too.
- Effects: 74 beat synced effects (delays, reverbs, filters, modulation, slicing, pitch and time,
  distortion, macros) in two or four FX units, group or single mode, insert, post fader or send.
- Drum Machine: any FX unit becomes a step sequencer in time with the master clock. Build your
  own kits and patterns (eight per kit, 1/4, 1/8 or 1/16 beat steps per row), and share them as
  .bskit files.
- Sample decks: four slots of stacked cells per deck, loop or one shot, gate or latch, keylock,
  punch in, reverse, and per slot volume, filter and FX send. Sample sets are saved in the library.
- Loop recorder: 4 to 32 beat loops from the master, cue, external or aux input, with overdub and
  undo. Any active deck loop can be saved as a loop too.
- Mix recorder: WAV in 16 bit, 24 bit or 32 bit float, optionally split by file size.
- Library: BPM, beatgrid, key and EBU R128 loudness analysis; search with filters such as
  `techno $BPM ~ 128`; playlists, smartlists, favorites, ratings, history, configurable columns
  and keyboard navigation. Imports NML collections and .tsi mappings, and reads Serato, VirtualDJ
  and Engine DJ libraries.
- Layouts: Micro, Essential, Full or Advanced decks, or parallel waveform lanes. Saved layouts.
- Themes: Dark, Light, Darcula, Solar, Purple and Ocean.

## Supported audio formats

MP3, AAC/M4A, ALAC, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, Ogg Vorbis and .stem.mp4.

## Controllers

- Native HID drivers: Kontrol S4 MK3 (tested on hardware, with its own screen layouts); Kontrol
  S4 MK2, S2 MK3, S2 MK2, S3, MX2 and Z1 (untested).
- MIDI profiles: Pioneer DJ DDJ series, Denon DJ MC7000, Hercules DJControl Inpulse 200/300/500,
  Numark Mixtrack Pro FX and Platinum FX, Reloop READY and Buddy.
- Anything else: MIDI learn and keyboard mappings.

## Install

Download a build from https://github.com/suitux/Backspn/releases. Beta builds are not notarised
or signed yet: on macOS open the app once, then choose Open Anyway in System Settings > Privacy &
Security; on Windows choose More info > Run anyway in SmartScreen.

To build from source you need stable Rust, CMake and a C/C++ compiler with libclang:

```
git clone https://github.com/suitux/Backspn
cd Backspn
cargo run --release -p backspn-app
```

## Privacy

Backspn can send an anonymous summary of counts once a day (version, system, settings, usage
counts). Nothing is sent until the user answers the notice on first launch, and it can be turned
off in Preferences or with BACKSPN_INSIGHTS=0. Track, artist and playlist names, file paths, tags,
device names and IP addresses are never sent. Public results: https://backspn.com/insights
